When the node refuses to join
Error ERR-4712 means the node refused to join the pool because its key does not match the signed one.
The fix is short and it must be done in this order.
Read the serial plate and write the last four characters down.
Compare them with the last four characters of the key on the printed sheet.
If they differ, the wrong sheet was printed: get a new sheet from the worksh…

If the soak test fails
A scene that does not trigger usually means a sensor is paired to the wrong room.
A panel that resets means the power supply is underloaded; check what else is on the circuit.
A node that works but is not visible on the network is a network issue, not a node issue, and the node should not be replaced.

On site
Unpack in the room, not in the corridor. The room is where the network is.
Fix the node to the wall bracket, at the height given on the drawing.
Connect the sensors, one at a time, and check each one before the next.
Connect the network lead last, after the sensors answer locally.
Run the twenty-minute soak test with the lights at full and the blinds closed.
Photograph the finished bracke…

When a document is refused
Error ERR-6083 appears when an invoice line carries no cost centre and the sync refuses the whole document.
The document stays in the project folder with a note in the log, and the milestone is not invoiced. Do not send the client a reminder for an invoice that has not been raised.

We do not give new joiners a laptop on their first day without a configuration check.
We do not schedule project work in the first two weeks of a workshop role.
We do not let a team leader run an onboarding without a buddy, even in a small team.
We do not treat the training log as paperwork to be filed; the team lead reads it.

Le client voulait un calendrier de dix-huit mois sans marge. L'atelier ne peut pas s'engager sur un calendrier serré sans des conditions de production plus dures, et nous l'avons dit clairement. Nous avons proposé un premier lot en douze mois et un second lot conditionné à la vérification du sol, ce qui a été accepté.

La suite
Le chiffrage par établissement est la prochaine étape. Ana le valide, Lyon le rédige, et l'atelier donne les délais en semaines pour chaque lot.

The decision
The workshop meeting decided to rebuild the paint line and the finishing cell before the museum installation, moving the goods-in aisle and giving the finishing cell its own staging area.
The reorganisation of the paint line and the finishing cell, codenamed ATELIER-BRIDGE, starts in week 34 and runs until the end of January.

Les quatre étapes
Découverte : nous avons un besoin, un budget indicatif et aucun plan.
Proposition : une offre chiffrée avec un jeu de plans complet.
Négociation : le client demande des modifications, le volet commercial se négocie.
Gagné : le contrat est signé et l'acompte est facturé.
Une étape ne dépasse jamais six semaines sans une note écrite. La règle est la même qu'au nord.
